data.title: Is Anthropic IPO Really Hurting Bitcoin? Analyst Points To A Bigger Problem Behind BTC’s Slide
data.description: Bitcoin’s (BTC) latest slide has analysts on Wall Street debating whether investors are selling crypto to free up cash for the biggest technology IPO this week. As Anthropic prepares for its public debut, some market watchers have drawn a parallel between Bitcoin’s decline and the lead-up to SpaceX…
